an8.58:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭhahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an8.58:1.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti. …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an8.58:1.5: āraddhaviriyo viharati thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an8.58:1.7: aratirati saho hoti, uppannaṃ aratiṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya viharati.
an8.58:1.8: bhayabheravasaho hoti, uppannaṃ bhayabheravaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya viharati.
an8.58:1.9: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an8.58:1.11: imehi kho bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
